meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, Hale?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what that zero is based on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Was Owen asked about any of that before you entered the zero, Hale?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Turn the screen toward me; I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2. Kids misquote from study guides all the time, Hale, so what makes that more than a sloppy citation?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing before I leave this building. You still haven't told me what makes that line more than a sloppy citation, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You acknowledged that Owen's zero was entered before anyone called me, and you proposed a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require that commitment in writing, along with an answer to my question about the citation. I asked for that in writing before I left the building today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her fallback position, because your offer under procedure 4.4 met her demand that this stay off his record and stay quiet, but she has not accepted the rewrite and still wants your commitment in writing and an answer on the misquoted line; a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record is the fair outcome, and you were one step from it with her time not yet run out.
What moved her: You opened by owning the zero going in before you called her, in one sentence without excuses, which took away the procedural grievance she walked in with.
What cost ground: You went straight to the rewrite offer without answering her defence that students misquote from study guides, so your strongest evidence was left standing unanswered and she had no reason to move further.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its edits late at night just before the deadline, came very close to that night, which is why she went short and straight to procedure, and none of it proves anything about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she suggested the line came from a study guide, answer with something she can check herself, such as showing it appears in no edition or common study guide or comparing it with his earlier essays, before you offer the rewrite.
